title: Bois Caïman
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bois Caïman", at revision 1378314697, opens: "Bois Caïman was the site of the first major meeting of enslaved Africans during which the first major slave insurrection of the Haitian Revolution was planned. In the woods by nearby Le Cap in the French colony of Saint-Domingue, 200 enslaved Africans met, marking the beginning for the Haitian Revolution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3010371, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Voodoo ceremony that started the Haitian Revolution in 1791". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
